description: Five-mode LightRAG run over the 10 priority tickers, answers generated inside LightRAG
hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 SUPER, 12 GB (from the notebook output)

index.note: counts from the workspace load message in the notebook output; the workspace was built before this run
index.embedding_model: intfloat/e5-mistral-7b-instruct, 4-bit NF4 on CUDA, mean pooling, max_length 512, 4096 dimensions

query.order: modes run in the order listed, one question at a time
query.keyword_extraction: one new keyword cache entry in the log; all other keyword sets were read from the workspace's LLM cache, written by earlier queries on the same index

questions.selection: ticker written as (XXX) or at the end after a comma or dash, one of the 10 tickers

ragas.script: the sequential RAGAS batch script (now batch_ragas_evaluation.py --strategy sequential), which writes batch_ragas_evaluation_results_ultra_simple.json
ragas.inputs: question, answer, the whole retrieved_context as one context string, expected_answer as ground_truth

outcome.query_results: 315 of 315 question-mode results have status success; no answer is empty or a Gemini error string
